topic: Deferred-interest "same as cash" financing -- miss the payoff date by a day and months of interest hit retroactively
title: How '0% Interest' Deals Can Cost You Hundreds
description:
Deferred interest promotions, advertised as 'same as cash' or '0% interest,' have a hidden clause that can be incredibly expensive. If you don't pay off the entire balance by the end of the promotional period, you're charged all the interest that accrued from day one.
